comment: Independent teleport.c witness for mlevel_tele_trap() reached outside a monster's own turn: the debug Samurai steps east, wishes a level teleporter there, steps east again, wishes a fountain and quaffs. A monster that drinkfountain() summons (fountain.c dowatersnakes(), dowaterdemon() or dowaternymph()) lands on the level teleporter, so trap.c mintrap() -> trapeffect_level_telep() -> mlevel_tele_trap() sends it away through dog.c migrate_to_level().
